config.label: Hostname or IP of your HomeMatic CCU (debmatic, CCU3, or OpenCCU/RaspberryMatic)
config.description: Hostname or IP of your HomeMatic CCU (debmatic, CCU3, or OpenCCU/RaspberryMatic)

config.label: CCU admin password (same as the WebUI login)
config.description: CCU admin password (same as the WebUI login)

config.label: CCU username
config.description: CCU username

config.label: Connect to the CCU via HTTPS (self-signed certificates supported)
config.description: Connect to the CCU via HTTPS (self-signed certificates supported)

config.label: CCU API port (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)
config.description: CCU API port (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS)

config.label: Directory for the device type cache and session persistence
config.description: Directory for the device type cache and session persistence

config.label: Comma-separated allowlist of browser origins
config.description: Comma-separated allowlist of browser origins. Unset = no cross-origin browser access (default-deny). An allowlisted origin is reflected exactly in Access-Control-Allow-Origin (never '*'); the list also drives DNS-rebinding origin checks

config.label: Extra Host header values accepted by DNS-rebinding protection (comma-separated host:port); add your hostname when behind a proxy or container DNS name
config.description: Extra Host header values accepted by DNS-rebinding protection (comma-separated host:port); add your hostname when behind a proxy or container DNS name

config.label: Comma-separated names of multiple CCU targets (e
config.description: Comma-separated names of multiple CCU targets (e.g. 'prod,dev'). Each profile takes the flat CCU_* settings prefixed CCU_<NAME>_ (CCU_PROD_HOST, ...), plus policy flags CCU_<NAME>_PROTECTED (writes need confirm:true) and CCU_<NAME>_READONLY. Unset = single default profile from the flat CCU_* vars

config.label: Which profile from CCU_PROFILES is active at startup (default: the first listed)
config.description: Which profile from CCU_PROFILES is active at startup (default: the first listed)

config.label: Verify the CCU's TLS certificate against the system trust store
config.description: Verify the CCU's TLS certificate against the system trust store. Only meaningful with CCU_HTTPS=true. Default false, because a CCU ships a self-signed certificate — prefer CCU_TLS_FINGERPRINT or CCU_CA_CERT to verify one of those

config.label: Pin the CCU's self-signed leaf certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (hex, colons optional)
config.description: Pin the CCU's self-signed leaf certificate by its SHA-256 fingerprint (hex, colons optional). The strongest option for an appliance: the connection is rejected unless the presented certificate matches. Takes precedence over CCU_CA_CERT

config.label: Path to a PEM file holding the CCU's CA or self-signed certificate
config.description: Path to a PEM file holding the CCU's CA or self-signed certificate. The connection is then validated against it with standard chain verification

config.label: Timeout for a CCU JSON-RPC call, in MILLISECONDS
config.description: Timeout for a CCU JSON-RPC call, in MILLISECONDS

config.label: Timeout for HomeMatic Script execution (ReGa), in MILLISECONDS — scripts are slower than plain API calls
config.description: Timeout for HomeMatic Script execution (ReGa), in MILLISECONDS — scripts are slower than plain API calls

config.label: Lifetime of the on-disk device-type schema cache, in SECONDS
config.description: Lifetime of the on-disk device-type schema cache, in SECONDS

config.label: Token-bucket burst size for CCU requests — how many may be issued back to back
config.description: Token-bucket burst size for CCU requests — how many may be issued back to back

config.label: Sustained CCU request rate, in requests per second
config.description: Sustained CCU request rate, in requests per second

config.label: How often MCP resources are polled for change notifications, in SECONDS
config.description: How often MCP resources are polled for change notifications, in SECONDS

config.label: error | warn | info | debug
config.description: error | warn | info | debug. Logs are structured JSON on stderr
